title: Konrad-Adenauer-Stiftung: International Scholarship Programme
summary: Study and doctoral funding for academically strong, socially engaged international applicants who want to study or research at a German university.

degree_levels.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

subject_areas.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

institutions.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

nationality.notes: The international programme is primarily aimed at non-EU applicants; the page expressly excludes German applicants from this route.

residence.notes: Domestic selection is available to applicants already in Germany; overseas applications use participating KAS offices, which vary by year.

mandatory.text: German language ability at least B2, including for English-taught degree programmes.
Bachelor's applicants must have completed at least two semesters; a later call-to-action uses different wording, so confirm the applicable study stage.
Master's applicants must intend to enrol in a four-semester programme; the minimum funding period is four semesters.
Doctoral applicants need full admission to a doctoral programme at a German university.
Above-average academic results, social or political engagement and commitment to democracy and human rights.
The international route does not fund human medicine or dentistry leading to state examinations, medical specialisation or postdoctoral projects.
Follow-up bridge funding from an existing scholarship is excluded, with an exception for moving from a previously funded degree to a new higher degree.

preferences.text: Volunteer experience in the applicant's home country is highly encouraged.

exceptions.text: A Master's applicant may apply before finishing the first degree if the transcript is provided and the certificate follows.
Doctoral research abroad can be allowed with justification and supervisor support, for at most 25% of the total funding period.

funding.description: Bachelor's, Master's and postgraduate awards up to EUR 992 monthly, normally two years; doctoral awards up to EUR 1,400 monthly, normally three years. Conditional insurance, family, child and research-travel support may apply; tuition reimbursement up to EUR 750 per semester is exceptional.
funding.duration: Normally two years for study and three years for a doctorate; programme-specific conditions apply.

application_rounds.notes: No confirmed application dates were established.

recurring_deadline_notes: Domestic applications: 15 July at 12:00 noon, labelled CET by the source, each year. Overseas office deadlines and selected countries vary. No new year-specific round is inferred.

steps.text: Choose the domestic route or a participating overseas KAS office.
Read the linked German application notes and checklist.
For the domestic route, upload the required documents through KAS Campus.
